_meta.purpose: The content-driven selection layer for a data-entry FORM. A form = an intro (title + optional context) + a stack of titled FIELDSET groups + a closing ACTION row, all in ONE narrow centered column. Each entry maps a CONTENT SHAPE (a group of related inputs, a choice question, a consent, an action) to a REGION or a FIELDSET/element. To compose: split the fields into task-meaningful groups, map each group to a fieldset, order them by the flow, then add the action row.
_meta.usage: Pick the best-fit fieldset/element per group of inputs. Prefer an existing block; author a new guideline-compliant one only when needed. Fill every placeholder with a real label; drop an optional field only when it does not apply. NEVER leave an empty Select/Input placeholder in the output.
_meta.patternSource: Each `pattern` id resolves in form/block-patterns.json; each block id in form/blocks.json.

intro.intent: Open the form: the form name (h1) + an optional one-line description, and optionally a form-level hint or error summary.
intro.whenToUse: Always, once, first. Title (h1) + optional short description. Add a form-level Infotext ('Pflichtfelder sind mit * markiert') when the form has required fields, or a Notification when there is context/an error summary to show.

actions.intent: Close the form with its primary submit and an optional secondary cancel/back.
actions.whenToUse: Always, once, last. A ContainerHorizontal with the primary submit (Brand) and an optional secondary (ghost/outlined). ≤1 Brand action per page.

fieldset.intent: A titled group of related fields — the core building block of the form.
fieldset.whenToUse: Every group of inputs that belong together (Persönliche Daten, Reisedaten, Zahlung, Kontakt …). A Heading (h2) + optional description + the stacked fields. 1–6 per form. A very short form MAY be a single fieldset with no h2 (the form h1 carries it).
fieldset.note: Fields inside are label-above and fillWidth. Two SHORT related fields may share a row via form.field-row.

text-field.intent: A single-line text input (name, e-mail, number, IBAN, …).
text-field.whenToUse: Any free-text single value. Label-above; add 'Show Required Asterisk' when required; pair with a helper Infotext for format hints/errors.

select-field.intent: A choice from a known, closed list (Anrede, Land, Reiseklasse …).
select-field.whenToUse: One value from a defined set that does not need radios (long or secondary lists). Label-above Select.

textarea-field.intent: A multi-line free-text field (Nachricht, Anmerkung, Begründung).
textarea-field.whenToUse: Longer free text. NOTE: the DB Textarea ships ONLY a 'Label Above – Filled' variant, so it always renders in the filled style — set the Label and treat it as the only available variant (do not approximate an empty state).

field-row.intent: Two SHORT related fields side by side (Vorname/Nachname, PLZ/Ort, Von/Bis).
field-row.whenToUse: Only when both fields are short and belong to the same logical line. A 50-50 Grid so the two fields share the column width. Never force a long field or a field + button into a Grid.

radio-group.intent: One choice from 2–5 mutually exclusive options that should all be visible.
radio-group.whenToUse: A single-choice question where seeing all options matters (Reiseklasse, Zahlungsart). A group label (h3/Body bold) + stacked Radios. Prefer a Select when the list is long or secondary.

checkbox-group.intent: Multiple independent on/off choices under one question.
checkbox-group.whenToUse: A multi-select question (Interessen, Zusatzleistungen). A group label + stacked Checkboxes.

switch-row.intent: A single on/off SETTING with an immediate meaning (Newsletter, Benachrichtigungen).
switch-row.whenToUse: Settings-style toggles, one per row. Prefer a Checkbox inside a data-entry form; use a Switch for a preference/setting that reads as 'on/off now'.

consent.whenToUse: Near the end, before the action row. A single Checkbox whose label references the terms (a Link may follow as a sibling line). Usually required.

form-info.intent: A form- or fieldset-level hint or error/context summary.
form-info.whenToUse: Infotext for a neutral hint ('Pflichtfelder …'); a Notification (semantic Critical/Warning/Informational) for an error summary or important context. Placed at the top of the intro or the affected fieldset — never its own section.
